title: Neonatal Jaundice: Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices of Mothers and Medical Trainees and Providers in and Around Ogbomosho
brief_summary: Determine the knowledge attitude and practices of all levels of health care providers about neonatal jaundice
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All Mothers and Health Care Workers willing to fill out survey in and around Ogbomoso, Nigeria

Exclusion Criteria:

* All Mothers and Health Care Workers not willing to fill out survey in an around Ogbomoso, Nigeria
study_population: Health Care providers and Mothers with neonates in for routine childcare visits
